---
title: "check-quarto-website.yml"
---

Bundles the standard check suite for Quarto website repositories
(such as [`Morrison-Lab/qwt`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/qwt)).
Replaces individual workflow files with a single composite action
or reusable workflow call.

## What it runs

Runs the full Morrison-Lab repository hygiene pass
plus website-specific checks:

- [`check-junk-files.yml`](check-junk-files.qmd):
  OS and editor detritus (`.DS_Store`, `Thumbs.db`, `.Rhistory`, etc.)
- [`check-secrets.yml`](check-secrets.qmd):
  Gitleaks scan of git history for committed credentials and tokens
- [`check-non-standard-chars.yml`](check-non-standard-chars.qmd):
  flags non-standard unicode characters, curly quotes, and smart dashes
- [`check-new-line-breaks.yml`](check-new-line-breaks.qmd):
  enforces semantic line breaks on modified lines in diffs
- [`check-typos.yml`](check-typos.qmd):
  crate-ci/typos CLI scan for spelling errors on modified files
- [`check-ai-tells.yml`](check-ai-tells.qmd):
  scans narrative prose (`*.md`, `*.qmd`) for AI cliches and tells
- [`lint-yaml.yml`](lint-yaml.qmd):
  yamllint over tracked YAML files
- [`lint-workflows.yml`](lint-workflows.qmd):
  actionlint and zizmor over GitHub Actions workflows
- [`lint-markdown.yml`](lint-markdown.qmd):
  markdownlint-cli2 over tracked Markdown files
- [`lint-qmd.yml`](lint-qmd.qmd):
  markdownlint over prose sections of tracked `.qmd` files
- [`check-links.yml`](check-links.qmd):
  lychee link checker for website pages, references, and external links
- [`check-quarto-links.yml`](check-quarto-links.qmd):
  relative links from `.qmd`/`.md`/`.Rmd` sources to pages that do not exist,
  which Quarto only warns about and lychee does not read out of a `.qmd`
- [`check-orphaned-images.yml`](check-orphaned-images.qmd):
  tracked images that no source file references (warn-only by default)
- [`check-typed-output.yml`](check-typed-output.qmd):
  typed or faked code output in Quarto sources (warn-only by default)
- [`check-informal-definitions.yml`](check-informal-definitions.qmd):
  flags technical concepts defined in running prose
  rather than formal Quarto definition divs (`::: {#def-...}`)
  (warn-only by default)
- [`check-bibliography-dois.yml`](check-bibliography-dois.qmd):
  validates BibTeX bibliography entries in `.bib` files

Every check is enabled by default.
Opt out of any specific check by passing its boolean flag as `false`
(for example, `check-links: false` to skip link validation
in an offline environment).

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fail` | boolean | `true` | Fail the job on findings (else warn only). |
| `check-junk-files` | boolean | `true` | Enable junk files check. |
| `junk-patterns` | string | see `check-junk-files.qmd` | Gitignore patterns naming junk files. |
| `junk-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Paths to exempt from junk files scan. |
| `check-secrets` | boolean | `true` | Enable gitleaks secrets scan. |
| `secrets-config` | string | `''` | Custom gitleaks config file path. |
| `secrets-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Regex paths to exempt from secrets scan. |
| `check-non-standard-chars` | boolean | `true` | Enable non-standard character check. |
| `non-standard-chars-extensions` | string | `'.qmd, .md'` | File extensions to check for non-standard characters. |
| `check-new-line-breaks` | boolean | `true` | Enable semantic line break check. |
| `new-line-breaks-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref for diff-scoping new line breaks. |
| `new-line-breaks-globs` | string | `''` | Globs to check for new line breaks. |
| `check-typos` | boolean | `true` | Enable typos check. |
| `typos-config` | string | `''` | Typos configuration file path. |
| `typos-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref for diff-scoping typo checks. |
| `check-ai-tells` | boolean | `true` | Enable AI tells check on prose. |
| `ai-tells-threshold` | string | `'10'` | Maximum allowed tell density (per 1,000 words). |
| `ai-tells-ignore` | string | `''` | Comma- or space-separated list of tells to ignore. |
| `lint-yaml` | boolean | `true` | Enable YAML linting. |
| `yaml-config-file` | string | `''` | Custom yamllint config file path. |
| `yaml-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Patterns to exclude from YAML linting. |
| `lint-workflows` | boolean | `true` | Enable workflow linting. |
| `workflows-path` | string | `'.'` | Path to workflow files. |
| `lint-markdown` | boolean | `true` | Enable Markdown linting. |
| `markdown-config-file` | string | `''` | Markdownlint config file path. |
| `markdown-globs` | string | `'*.md'` | Git pathspecs of Markdown files to lint. |
| `markdown-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Paths to exempt from Markdown linting. |
| `markdown-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref for list-item splice checks. |
| `lint-qmd` | boolean | `true` | Enable QMD prose linting. |
| `qmd-config-file` | string | `''` | Markdownlint config file for QMD files. |
| `qmd-globs` | string | `'*.qmd'` | Pathspecs of QMD files to lint. |
| `qmd-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Patterns to skip for QMD linting. |
| `check-links` | boolean | `true` | Enable lychee link checker. |
| `lychee-config` | string | `''` | Path to a custom lychee config file. |
| `lychee-args` | string | `'--exclude-mail'` | Command-line arguments for lychee. |
| `check-quarto-links` | boolean | `true` | Enable the check for links to missing Quarto pages; blocking or not follows `fail`. |
| `quarto-links-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Globs of source files to skip for the Quarto links check. |
| `check-orphaned-images` | boolean | `true` | Enable the orphaned-images report. |
| `orphaned-images-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Globs of images to skip. |
| `orphaned-images-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref so only images added since it are reported; empty examines every image. |
| `orphaned-images-fail` | boolean | `false` | Fail on an orphaned image; the report warns only by default, whatever `fail` says. |
| `check-typed-output` | boolean | `true` | Enable the check for typed or faked code output. |
| `typed-output-globs` | string | `'*.qmd'` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check. |
| `typed-output-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Patterns to skip for typed output check. |
| `typed-output-diff-scoped` | boolean | `false` | Report only findings on lines added since `typed-output-base-ref`. |
| `typed-output-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref for diff-scoped typed output check. |
| `typed-output-fail` | boolean | `false` | Fail on typed code output; the check warns only by default, whatever `fail` says. |
| `check-informal-definitions` | boolean | `true` | Enable check for informal definitions in prose. |
| `informal-definitions-globs` | string | `'*.qmd'` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check. |
| `informal-definitions-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Patterns to skip for informal definitions check. |
| `informal-definitions-diff-scoped` | boolean | `false` | Report only findings on lines added since `informal-definitions-base-ref`. |
| `informal-definitions-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref for diff-scoped informal definitions check. |
| `informal-definitions-fail` | boolean | `false` | Fail on informal definitions; the check warns only by default, whatever `fail` says. |
| `check-bibliography-dois` | boolean | `true` | Enable bibliography DOI validation. |
| `bib-exclude-keys` | string | `''` | BibTeX keys to skip for DOI validation. |

## Example

```yaml
name: Check Quarto website

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  check:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-quarto-website.yml@v3
```
